name_reason: Name is spec-compliant and accurate. Prefix data_fd2_; domain ui (a user-configured settings/options-menu flag); descriptor game_speed_flag reflects both purpose (game-speed toggle) and datatype (boolean flag). No Ghidra address residue. Semantics confirmed: 0 = Slow, 1 = Fast, toggled by XOR byte [0x53AF9],1 in fd2_game_options_menu_loop; read by battle fast-mode paths and save/load. Single live name in Ghidra (data_fd2_ui_game_speed_flag) matches src/include/globals.h and src/life/main.c.
purpose: One-byte boolean game-speed toggle (0 = Slow, 1 = Fast) set from the game-options menu and persisted in the save state; gates battle fast-mode behavior.
logic_summary: Strictly binary flag. fd2_game_options_menu_loop renders the Speed menu label as 0x16 + (flag != 0) (0x16 Slow / 0x17 Fast) and toggles it with flag ^= 1 when the Speed item (cursor idx 2) is selected. In battle, fast mode (flag != 0) makes fd2_maybe_load_speed_mode_overlay load the FDOTHER.DAT[0x40] streamlined walk-anim overlay (freed by fd2_maybe_free_speed_mode_overlay), and fd2_execute_ai_offensive_spell / fd2_execute_ai_physical_attack skip the basic cast/attack animation sequence for low spell ids. Persisted in FD2.SAV (byte) at single-slot +0x30D1 and multi-slot slot +0xA07; restored by fd2_load_save_and_init_engine and fd2_load_state_from_selected_slot; written/read on the slot side by fd2_save_current_state_to_slot and fd2_main_menu_continue_dispatcher. fd2_field_menu_status_save_load_quit_dispatch also reads it.
element_semantics: Scalar boolean: 0 = Slow/normal game speed (default), 1 = Fast mode. Only ever accessed at 8-bit width; toggled via XOR ...,1.
comment_original_issue: src comment block (main.c lines 587-604) was already accurate, precise, and ASCII; kept unchanged. Ghidra side: documentation was stored in the wrong field (PRE_COMMENT, not PLATE_COMMENT per project_ghidra_data_plate_mechanism) and contained inaccuracies vs verified evidence -- it described a non-existent 'slow / normal / fast' tri-state (flag is strictly binary, toggled by XOR ...,1), speculated about 'dialog typewriter pace, walk step delay ...many more downstream timing-sensitive code paths' (actual readers are a fixed enumerable set), and mislabeled fd2_maybe_load_speed_mode_overlay as a 'speed indicator overlay' (it loads the FDOTHER.DAT[0x40] fast-mode walk-anim overlay).
notes: src/life/main.c comment block unchanged (already correct), so only the shard is staged for this symbol. Ghidra: created a corrected PLATE_COMMENT at 0x53AF9 and cleared the stale/misleading PRE_COMMENT (data plate must be PLATE_COMMENT). Live Ghidra name confirmed data_fd2_ui_game_speed_flag, datatype undefined1, len 1. No logic issues found.
